work.description: DCCLXII: whole Pastoralis officii five-clause brief addressed to Portuensis et Sanctae Rufinae bishop, Fazj/Piazzoni foundations, endowment and daily/feast mass obligations, consolidation and execution powers, legal/derogation clauses and full datum LF60958–60963. XML leaves455 right→456 L/R→457 left normal substantive continuation, no wide joined rows. Own protocol literal Pius PP, VIL is retained mechanically; closing pontificate and running headers corroborate Pius VII. No printed separate subscription or omission. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
